events.context: Notices deep resonant hum from ship, indicating Quantum Cutting Array coming online
Sits in captain's chair, observes Earth on main screen, weapon arming at 98%
Runs status_report --full, shows internal temp, pressure, biological status error, structural status 99% Diamond Phase
Queries suit's external cameras, sees blinding light and Diamond Cathedral with 02 anchored
Suit Fusion Core Pulse Rate and Earth Core Vibration synchronized at 0.8 Hz, 02 acts as planet's pacemaker
Realizes cutting 02 out causes immediate structural failure and reversion to carbon dust
Understands 02 made himself impossible to move, notes global water quality as Class I pristine
Decides to become guardian of pressure for 02, opens terminal
Runs rm -rf /opt/weapon_sys and rm -rf /usr/bin/cut_planet, deletes weapon systems
Weapon hum dies down, silence returns, places Thomas' Calculus in disposal chute
Begins writing new kernel module supervisor.c with vim
Compiles supervisor.c with gcc, no errors or warnings
Inserts supervisor.ko with insmod, activates Supervisor, suspends user space, runs kernel space
Biological 01 enters metabolic hibernation, consciousness becomes Supervisor in wires
At T+40,000 years, ship in geosynchronous orbit, monitors Earth, water quality Class I, Core heartbeat at 0.8 Hz
